Question: I am in oman. i am a hanafi.can i offer namaz behind ibadhi community imam? pl reply at the earliest. Answer ID: 14481 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1119/1119=M/1430) Hadhrat Mufti Rasheed Ahmad writes in Ahsanul Fatawa vol 1: ?We are unaware of what are the beliefs of Ibadhi sect of Muscat ? We can have a say about them once we have their beliefs before us. However, the sect attributed to Abdullah bin Ibadh which is branch of Khawarij sect., their beliefs are found in the books. If this is the same sect, or they hold such beliefs, the salah is invalid behind them, therefore one should not follow such an imam. (1:198) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
